primary_endpoint: Change in transient hepatic elastography (THE) parameters from one week before surgery to three months after surgery.
efficacy_outcome: THE decreased from 8.13 to 5.53 kPa with sleeve gastrectomy versus 9.25 to 8.81 kPa with gastric bypass (between-group P=.004). CAP decreased from 287 to 242 dB/m versus 290 to 276 dB/m, respectively (P<.0001).
